text: Find Eikthyr’s Vegvisir at the Sacrificial Stones.
Bring Deer Trophy to the Forsaken Altar.
Look for The Elder’s Vegvisir in Burial Chambers or ruined structures.
Bring Ancient Seed to the Forsaken Altar.
Look for Bonemass’ Vegvisir in Sunken Crypts or ruined structures.
Bring Withered Bone to the Forsaken Altar.
Look for Moder’s Vegvisir in ruined structures in the Mountains.
Bring Dragon Egg to the Forsaken Altar.
Look for Yagluth’s Vegvisir at Stonehenge structures.
Bring Fuling Totem to the Forsaken Altar.
Look for The Queen’s Vegvisir in Infested Mines.
Use Sealbreaker to enter the Infested Citadel.
Look for Fader’s Vegvisir in the central tower of Charred Fortresses.
Craft Bell from Bell Fragment before visiting the altar.
Reach The Prison through the Aesir Passage.
Offer Malicious Blood at the Strange Bowl.
World-based events are the default mode.
Raids do not start while the player is in a dungeon.
Stay in the event area until the timer runs out; it pauses without players, except during the hunted event.
The biome check uses the exact biome at your position.
Environmental deaths can also unlock creature-based events.
Protect tamed creatures during raids.
